subject: Carryover credits request for Oct 3 HyperData workshop
messages:
From: Sara Voss <sara@hyperdata.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: DevCon Events <devcon-events@partnerco.com>
Date: 2027-10-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Carryover credits request for Oct 3 HyperData workshop

Hi Soojin / Marissa,

Thanks again for sponsoring the HyperData workshop on Oct 3 — turnout was great. Quick follow-up: roughly 120 EU-based registrants were unable to redeem the workshop promo code at signup due to a regional enforcement bug on our side (we patched it, apologies). Those attendees were promised short-term trial credits as part of the workshop experience.

Can Redwood either:
- extend the existing promo codes for those impacted by 90 days, or
- issue replacement single-use promo codes that expire 30 days from issuance

Attached is a CSV of impacted emails and the promo code originally assigned. We're hoping for a 500-token-equivalent per attendee (we can be flexible).

If you need a PO or anything from our side, let me know — we can cover any incremental spend within the co-marketing bucket for this event. We just want to make good on the promise to attendees.

Attendee file: attendee_list_oct3.csv (attached)

Best,
Sara Voss
Head of Partnerships | HyperData
sara@hyperdata.ai

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Sara Voss <sara@hyperdata.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-06T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Carryover credits request for Oct 3 HyperData workshop

Hi Sara — thanks for the quick note and for sending the list. Really appreciate the context.

Two pragmatic paths here (we'll stand up whichever is fastest):
1) Extend the original workshop promo code(s) by 90 days and top up the remaining balance to cover 500 tokens per impacted attendee.
2) Issue replacement single-use codes (one per email) each worth 500 tokens, expiring 30 days after we send them.

Budget note: partner co-marketing will cover up to 100k tokens total for October events without additional approvals. If we need more than that we'll loop finance.

Marissa / Grace — can you confirm which execution you prefer and whether we should create single-use codes or push an extension? If single-use, I'll ask ops to generate the codes and provide a CSV we can hand off to HyperData for distribution.

Sara — ETA for us would be: confirmation today/tomorrow, codes ready within 24 hours of confirmation.

Thanks,
Soojin
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Voss <sara@hyperdata.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-07T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Carryover credits request for Oct 3 HyperData workshop

Looping here — after a quick look at the attendee list, 120 impacted emails x 500 tokens = 60,000 tokens. That sits comfortably under the 100k co-marketing threshold, so this doesn't need a full procurement PO.

Preference: issue replacement single-use codes (one per email) so HyperData can resend by address and we avoid double-redemption edge cases. Let's use a campaign suffix: HD-WKSHP-2027-EXT.

Attached is a quick cost estimate for the 60k tokens (cost-estimate.xlsx).

Aditya — could you confirm nominal approval for issuing 60k tokens from co-marketing funds? If yes, Ops (Grace) will generate 120 single-use codes valued at 500 tokens each and set expiry 2028-01-31 (90 days). We'll record the change on the HubSpot deal and mark this as co-marketing credit.

Marissa
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Carryover credits request for Oct 3 HyperData workshop

Approved.

Finance confirms 60,000 tokens from the Q4 co-marketing allocation for HyperData. Please proceed with option: issue 120 single-use promo codes at 500 tokens each. Expiry: 2028-01-31.

Operational notes:
- Ops (Grace) to generate codes and deliver a CSV with code/email mapping to HyperData; redact tokens in public docs.
- Marissa to update HubSpot: deal HP-2027-WKSHP-44, add note "carryover credit issued — 60k tokens" and attach signed approval.
- Soojin to notify HyperData and confirm distribution timing.

I uploaded a signed approval PDF to the shared drive and attached it here (signed-carryover-approval.pdf).

Thanks all — please confirm when codes are sent so we can close the loop.

-Aditya
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
attachment: signed-carryover-approval.pdf
